verdict.rationale: Together AI's docs say an OpenAI client can be pointed at Together-hosted models with only two changes, the API key and the base URL. Its API reference documents a standard POST /v1/chat/completions endpoint, so an agent can switch providers through configuration rather than code changes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of drop-in switching, and a documented parameter/feature compatibility matrix (e.g., how tool-calling and structured-output fields map to the OpenAI schema).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes

citations.quote: you can point it at models hosted on Together with two changes: the API key and base URL.
